text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error rate detected on /v1/generate (eu-west-1). Severity: P1. Trigger: 5xx spike + deploy finished 3m ago. Suspected: secrets/config change during deploy. Paging alex.oncall.

alex.oncall: On it. Can someone post the error logs? Which service rolled?

maria.release: I just pushed the key-rotation rollout for model artifact access (region gated). Canary finished ~4m ago. No errors in CI.

maria.release: Logs from one failing host: 
```
2026-02-18T15:03:10Z ERROR fetch_artifact: decrypt error: AccessDeniedException: Key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:key/xxxx not found
2026-02-18T15:03:10Z ERROR request_handler: upstream 502 to client
```

sre-jen: That looks like decryption failure when fetching model artifacts. Could be rotated key id or missing IAM permission on the node role.

devops-tyler: Confirming impact: metric shows ~30% of eu-west-1 workers failing decrypt, requests falling back and returning 5xx. Other regions normal.

alex.oncall: Can we flip the feature flag to disable the rotated-key rollout? Flag name?

maria.release: Flag is feature/rotated-kms-2026-02. I can flip but need support to confirm it affects artifact fetch path only.

sre-jen: Flipping flag should stop new artifact fetch path and use legacy key until we fix IAM. Command to flip via FF service: 
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"key":"feature/rotated-kms-2026-02","state":"off","target":"eu-west-1"}'
```

alex.oncall: Doing it now.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: feature/rotated-kms-2026-02 set to OFF for eu-west-1 by alex.oncall at 15:06:12 UTC.

devops-tyler: Rolling metrics... error rate dropping on the next minute window. But a subset still failing, looks like cached processes still using failed key.

maria.release: I'll kick a rolling restart of the canary pool to pick up the older key path. Running: `deploy restart --pool canary-eu-west-1 --reason=rollback-rotated-key`

cs-linda: Noting customer impact: a handful of enterprise tenants (acct-9876, acct-1122) reported 500s starting 15:03 UTC. CS has reached out and informed them we're investigating and implementing mitigation.

alex.oncall: Sam, can you take second-level oncall for verification and postmortem? I'm staying to coordinate rollback and comms.

sam.oncall: Taking handoff. Watching logs/metrics. Please add anything for postmortem.

maria.release: Restart completed on canary pool at 15:10. Artifact fetch now succeeding on restarted instances.

devops-tyler: Error rate back to baseline in eu-west-1. No further 5xx spikes in last 5m.

ops-bot: :mega: Incident status update: mitigated — feature flag OFF + canary restart. Root cause suspected: partial IAM policy missing for newly deployed node role during KMS key rotation rollout, leading to decrypt failures for some hosts.

sre-jen: Action items: 1) Verify IAM role bindings across regional node pools; 2) Add a preflight that tests KMS decrypt after key rotation in a canary; 3) Extend feature flag gating to require IAM checks; 4) Run audit for roles touched in last deploy.

alex.oncall: Agreed. Maria, can you file the rollback postmortem and include exact timestamps, commands, and affected customers? Put it on the incidents board and tag cs-linda.

maria.release: Will do. I'll draft the postmortem, include the FF toggle timeline and restart commands.

cs-linda: Please include the customer impact blurb and notify impacted customers when the postmortem is ready. Thanks team. :pray:

sam.oncall: I'll take the follow-up on IAM validation and add a checklist item for future rotations.

ops-bot: :tada: Incident resolved at 15:17:30 UTC. Metrics normal. Postmortem required.

alex.oncall: Closing the loop here. Thanks everyone for fast moves.

maria.release: Quick note — we found that the Terraform change introduced a policy-scoped variable that was null for the canary role, leading to unmet KMS:Decrypt permission. Fix coming in main.

sre-jen: Marking P1 -> postmortem. We'll schedule a 30-min follow-up to review changes and action owners.

ops-bot: Automatically created incident ticket INC-20260218-402 with severity P1 and owners: alex.oncall, maria.release, sre-jen, sam.oncall.
